ev.q: Nationally weighted prevalence of meeting at least one criterion, and two or more criteria, for DREAMS eligibility were estimated
Among all adolescent girls and young women in Namibia, 62% were eligible for DREAMS based on meeting at least one criterion.
Namibia’s 2019 Violence Against Children and Youth Surveys found that 62% of girls and young women aged 13–24 years were eligible
Even among the group with the lowest prevalence (aged 15–19 years), 57% had at least one DREAMS criterion.
The Namibia VACS was a cross-sectional, nationally representative household cluster survey

methods_quotes.q: Nationally weighted prevalence of meeting at least one criterion, and two or more criteria, for DREAMS eligibility were estimated
All analyses were conducted using SAS (version 9.4; SAS Institute), accounting for the complex survey design.
* All results were weighted to account for the survey design.
Prevalence calculations were weighted to adjust for these responses.
